name: IntegrateIT Xbox
notes: Display-only Control4 AV source for an Xbox console (Series X|S, One — any HDMI Xbox). Exposes an HDMI OUT binding so the console can be wired to a TV, AVR, or matrix input and selected in Watch — one tap switches the room's video input and audio path to the Xbox. Controls nothing and reports nothing by design: there is no reliable one-cable power protocol for a console, so the driver does not pretend to have one. Wake the console from the controller (or HDMI-CEC); a future version may add network wake-on-demand.
